Site mentions: DeepSeek-R1 (6x) plus 6 distilled variants (Qwen-32B/14B/7B, Llama-70B, 0528-Qwen3-8B — ~30 combined mentions). DeepSeek's deepseek-reasoner alias (R1-generation thinking mode) deprecates 2026-07-24 per their own docs. Distilled variants are separate open-weight releases, not directly addressed by that deprecation notice — needs its own check next cycle, do not assume they're retired.
Qwen3.6-27B (2026-04-22) and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (2026-04-16) per Qwen's own GitHub org. Newest open generation as of this check.

744B params, 40B active (BF16). Z.ai's own README: 'marks a substantial leap in long-horizon task capability over its predecessor GLM-5.1', 1M-token context.

Site mentions 'GLM-5.1 32B' (4x) — but per Zhipu's own README, GLM-5.1/5.2 are the ~700B-class flagship generation (GLM-5 scaled from 355B to 744B total params); a '32B' variant does not match GLM-5.1's known parameter profile. This is likely a factual error on the site (possibly confusing GLM-4.5's 32B *active*-parameter figure with a GLM-5.1 model size) — flag as a correction candidate, not just a staleness update.

1T total / 32B active params, MoE. Site mentions 'Kimi K2.6' (4x) — could NOT verify a K2.6 release from any official Moonshot source (checked github.com/MoonshotAI org page, Kimi-K2 and Kimi-K2.5 repos, and the Kimi API newsletter blog; lineage confirmed is K1.5 -> K2 -> K2 Thinking / K2 Thinking Turbo -> K2.5, no K2.6). AWS Bedrock's Moonshot catalog independently stops at K2.5/K2-Thinking too. Git history shows the site's 'K2.6' active-param figure (32B) was corrected from an earlier wrong 42B on 2026-06-01, but the version label 'K2.6' was kept — the corrected 32B/1T figure exactly matches plain Kimi K2's real spec, not any K2.5/K2.6 release. Strong evidence 'Kimi K2.6' is a naming error for 'Kimi K2', not a staleness issue. See docs/MODEL_REGISTRY_REFRESH.md 2026-07 cycle notes before editing.
